MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

4. When practising Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Information.

5. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.

6. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language
